description: Update routing in App.tsx for new CRM pages, update Sidebar navigation with new CRM items (Follow-ups, Conversion Funnel), and add CRM widgets to the main Dashboard (Hot Leads, Pipeline Value, Overdue Follow-ups, Deals Closing This Week, mini conversion funnel).
steps: Update src/App.tsx: Add lazy imports for FollowUps and ConversionFunnel pages (lazy(() => import('@/pages/crm/FollowUps')) and lazy(() => import('@/pages/crm/ConversionFunnel'))). Add routes: path='crm/follow-ups' element={<FollowUps />} and path='crm/funnel' element={<ConversionFunnel />} inside the protected route group after the existing crm/activities route.

Update src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: Import CalendarClock and Filter icons from lucide-react. Add two new items to the CRM section of navSections array: { title: 'Follow-ups', href: '/crm/follow-ups', icon: CalendarClock } and { title: 'Conversion Funnel', href: '/crm/funnel', icon: Filter }. Place them after the existing Activities item.

Update src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Add a new section (motion.div) after the existing KPI cards or in place of the existing deal pipeline section. Add CRM KPI cards using the KPICard component: 'Hot Leads' (count of leads with score > 70, use useHotLeads or inline query), 'Pipeline Value' (total weighted value from usePipelineValue hook), 'Overdue Follow-ups' (count from useOverdueFollowUps, display warning color if > 5), 'Deals Closing This Week' (count of deals with expected_close_date within current week). Import and use the real hooks. Replace or supplement the existing static dealPipeline data with real data where possible. Keep existing dashboard sections intact but enhance with real CRM data where it fits naturally.
acceptance_criteria: Routes /crm/follow-ups and /crm/funnel are registered in App.tsx and render correctly
Sidebar CRM section shows Follow-ups (CalendarClock icon) and Conversion Funnel (Filter icon) after Activities
Dashboard shows CRM widgets with data from real hooks (useHotLeads, usePipelineValue, useOverdueFollowUps, or similar)
bun run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/stockflow-inventory-crm && bun run build' and confirm successful build with no TypeScript errors
